content.title: Aga Khan University Hosts the Critical Care Examination of CPSP
content.summary: Aga Khan University hosted the critical care examination of the College of Physicians & Surgeons Pakistan for the very first time in its Karachi campus at CIME.

content.text: Aga Khan University hosted the critical care examination of the College of Physicians & Surgeons Pakistan for the very first time in its Karachi campus at CIME.
The CPSP examination is renowned for its rigorous evaluation of medical graduates' aptitude across various specialties. The exam attracted medical graduates from around the country.
The exam featured multiple stations where candidates demonstrated their skills through Objective Structured Clinical Examinations (OSCE) under the expert guidance of experienced examiners.

The CPSP staff members, examiners and participants praised the state-of-the-art facilities and unwavering support provided by Aga Khan University, reflecting their high satisfaction and further cementing the institution's reputation for excellence in medical education. This successful examination exemplifies the strong collaboration between the Department of Anaesthesiology and the Centre for Innovation in Medical Education (CIME) at Aga Khan University.
